title: Import from Hevy
subtitle: Bring your workouts and measurements over and pick up where you left off.

howTo.title: Export your data in Hevy
howTo.step1: In the Hevy app, go to Profile → ⚙️ Settings.
howTo.step3: Tap “Export workouts” and, if you like, “Export measurements”. You get two .csv files.
howTo.step4: Choose them here. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

drop: Choose the files you exported from Hevy
